item.title: Obituary: Dr. Alan Butler Clark
item.description: Dr. Alan Butler Clark of West Orange, a former longtime resident of Montclair who had a long and distinguished career as a neurologist, serving at one point as the director of health for the City of Newark, died on Jan. 26, 2026.
